definitions: A plant that grows along the ground or climbs up walls and trees.
A person who behaves in an unpleasant or creepy way.
A small bird that climbs up tree trunks to find insects.
A low-profile wheeled platform used by mechanics to slide under vehicles.
examples: Ivy is a common garden creeper.
That guy at the bar was a total creeper.
The mechanic rolled under the car on his creeper.
